text:
Lena P (Partnerships): Sandstone Systems (HW partner) wants a compact LangChain + gateway bundle for their marketplace tile. They asked for a short sandbox, perf profile on their cluster, and co-marketing assets.

Vikram S (Eng): From eng: do they want LangChain adapter only or an end-to-end example with a vector DB (LlamaIndex) and routing rules?

Lena P (Partnerships): They prefer the full path: LangChain adapter + LlamaIndex example + a routing example that shows fallback to a smaller quantized model.

Noor A (DevEx): I can spin up a tiny demo repo and a GH workflow that deploys the gateway and sample app. Will include a README mapping repo -> marketplace asset. I'll open a PR tonight.

Sam T (Product): Marketplace checklist: SKU options, pricing band, supported topologies (hosted/dedicated/private), and a short note on upgrade path. I'll draft SKU copy by Wed.

Marta L (Marketing): Timeline? Sandstone wants to preview the bundle in early August. We need a 1-pager + 60s co-demo. Perf numbers needed to finalize copy.

Priya K (Legal): Send dataflow and coop wording. Suggest using "Validated with Sandstone Systems" not "Certified" until we complete a formal checklist. Also confirm what customer metadata (if any) hits our telemetry.

Vikram S (Eng): Perf matrix request: redwood-7b + redwood-13b-q4, seq 512/2048, batch 1/4/8. Also note: Sandstone's older drivers require a kernel flag for zero-copy; I'll document the workaround.

CI-Bot: perf job queued. Tag: sandstone-2498. Provide GCS path with prompts and model list CSV.

Noor A (DevEx): I'll upload prompts and config to gs://redwood-partners/sandstone-2498 and open the demo PR. Quick repro snippet for the workaround:
```
# workaround for older drivers
export REDWOOD_ZERO_COPY=0
./start-gateway --kv-cache
```

Sam T (Product): Add graceful-degradation copy: "Automatic fallback to a quantized variant or hosted instance under capacity constraints." Include in SKU description.

Marta L (Marketing): Will prepare draft slide that uses "Validated with Sandstone Systems" language. Need perf numbers before finalizing visuals.

Priya K (Legal): Once dataflow posted, I'll review and aim to clear wording in 3 business days. If firmware is required from Sandstone, that should be a partner-side responsibility callout in the listing.

Lena P (Partnerships): Action recap:
- Vikram: upload compatibility matrix + kernel note (due TOM)
- Noor: demo repo + prompts to GCS (due TOM morning)
- Priya: legal review after dataflow (3 business days)
- Marta: marketing slide + blurb after perf numbers
- Sam: SKU + marketplace copy (due Wed)

Noor A (DevEx): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-repo/sandstone-demo/pull/5 :rocket:

Vikram S (Eng): Kicked off perf runs after CI-Bot queued. Will paste raw numbers in the repo when done.

Lena P (Partnerships): Great. Sync Friday 8am PT to review perf and sign-off. Thanks all :raised_hands:
